newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian banks heavily overstaffed, says official.
newsitem.headline: Italian banks heavily overstaffed, says official.

text.p: Tancredi Bianchi, the president of the Association of Italian Banks (ABI), said on Wednesday the country's banks were heavily overstaffed and would have to cut their workforces.
Bianchi told a news conference that if Italy's banking system reached the same level of efficiency enjoyed by the country's top 10 banks, then it would have to lay off some 30,000 excess employees.
He said that number to be laid off could vary depending on how thoroughly the banking system was restructured.
Bianchi said the lay-offs would have to be discussed with the Labour Ministry and trades unions but there were no fixed plans for a meeting.
